title: USC OIS: Requirements for Reentry (curated summary)
text:
USC F-1 travel guidance distinguishes enrolled students, pending OPT/STEM applications, and approved OPT/STEM employment. Review the matching category before booking travel; circumstances and restrictions may change.
USC reentry checklist for enrolled F-1 students includes a suitably valid passport, an F-1 visa where required, and a current I-20 bearing a valid OIS travel endorsement. The source states that Canadian citizens are exempt from the visa requirement. It also lists financial-support evidence and recommended supporting records. Print and hand-sign the I-20 as instructed.
USC travel signatures are generally valid for 12 months for enrolled students and 6 months during OPT. Only an authorized OIS school official supplies the endorsement.
USC approved-OPT/STEM reentry guidance additionally lists the EAD, employment evidence if employed, and financial evidence. Pending applications have different document lists and travel cautions; an I-797 receipt alone does not establish a universal safe-to-travel rule. Consult OIS before travel with a pending application and review your I-94 after returning.
curation_note: Concise paraphrase checked against the linked USC page via web retrieval. Not a complete page snapshot or a substitute for OIS advice.
